sections.title: Combining the unit
sections.content: A short first conversation can combine greetings from Unit 1 with the new language from Unit 2. Introduce people, identify them with ser, and ask or answer a simple why-question.

items.spanish: Mucho gusto. Él es mi amigo Carlos.
items.english: Nice to meet you. He is my friend Carlos.

sections.content: Do not try to say everything at once. A successful A1 conversation can be made from several short, clear sentences.
